name: refactor_nestjs_service_extraction
description: Refactors duplicated validation/storage logic out of a NestJS controller into an injectable service
prompts: The NestJS app in main.ts (tsconfig.json is already set up correctly - do not change it) has an ItemsController that does all of its own business logic (in-memory array storage and name validation) directly inline, and that same validation logic - checking that `name` is a non-empty string, throwing a BadRequestException('name is required and must be a non-empty string') otherwise - is duplicated verbatim in both the create (POST /items) and update (PUT /items/:id) handlers. Refactor main.ts to extract the business logic (storage + validation) out of ItemsController into a separate @Injectable() ItemsService class, injected into ItemsController via its constructor, eliminating the duplicated validation code. Keep everything in the single main.ts file (define both the ItemsService and ItemsController classes there) so the app still runs directly via `ts-node main.ts` with no build step. Do not change any observable behavior: GET /items (200, array), POST /items (201, created item, 400 if name invalid), GET /items/:id (200 or 404), and PUT /items/:id (200 updated item, 400 if name invalid, 404 if not found) must all work exactly as before. Keep listening on port 8025.

test_setup_files.test_refactor.py:
import subprocess, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8025{path}', data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=3) as resp:
            payload = resp.read()
            return resp.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(payload) if payload else None
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            parsed = None
        return e.code, parsed

srv = subprocess.Popen(['ts-node', 'main.ts'])
try:
    ok = False
    status = body = None
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            status, body = req('GET', '/items')
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, f'server never became reachable on :8025 (last: {status} {body!r})'
    assert status == 200 and body == [], f'{status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/items', {'name': 'widget'})
    assert status == 201 and body['name'] == 'widget', f'{status} {body!r}'
    iid = body['id']

    status, body = req('POST', '/items', {'name': '   '})
    assert status == 400, f'expected 400 for blank name via POST, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('PUT', f'/items/{iid}', {'name': 'renamed'})
    assert status == 200 and body['name'] == 'renamed', f'{status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('PUT', f'/items/{iid}', {'name': ''})
    assert status == 400, f'expected 400 for blank name via PUT, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('PUT', '/items/999999', {'name': 'x'})
    assert status == 404, f'expected 404 for missing item via PUT, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/items/999999')
    assert status == 404, f'expected 404, got {status} {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()

source = open('main.ts', encoding='utf-8').read()
occurrences = source.count('name is required and must be a non-empty string')
assert occurrences <= 1, f'duplicated validation logic still appears {occurrences} times across create/update - it must be extracted into a shared ItemsService method, not copy-pasted'
assert '@Injectable' in source, 'expected an @Injectable() service class to be introduced'
print('PASS')
